-- shared/globals.go --
package shared

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"app/b"
)

// Viewer describes the current visitor.
type Viewer struct{ Name string }

type token string

// Label verifies that exported aliases to private targets are nameable.
type Label = token

// Directory is a wired global receiver.
type Directory struct {
	Greeter *Greeter
}

type Greeter struct{ Prefix string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewGreeter() *Greeter { return &Greeter{Prefix: "hello "} }

//fabrik:templates:global
func (d *Directory) CurrentUser(ctx context.Context) (*Viewer, error) {
	return &Viewer{Name: d.Greeter.Prefix}, nil
}

//fabrik:templates:global
func Greeting(ctx context.Context) string { return "hi" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Tag(ctx context.Context) Label { return Label("beta") }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Widget(ctx context.Context) b.Widget { return b.Widget{Label: "w"} }

//fabrik:templates:global name=nav
func ActivePrefix(ctx context.Context, prefix string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(prefix, "/") {
		return "active"
	}
	return ""
}

//fabrik:templates:global
func Badge(ctx context.Context, a1 string, _ int) string { return a1 }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Initial(ctx context.Context, b string) string { return b[:1] }
-- b/globals.go --
package b

import "context"

// Widget verifies cross-package result types.
type Widget struct{ Label string }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Motto(ctx context.Context) string { return "keep going" }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"

	"app/shared"
)

type Handlers struct {
	Directory *shared.Directory
	Templates *templates.Set
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func (h *Handlers) Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.Templates.Render(r.Context(), w, "home", nil)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"

	"app/b"
	"app/shared"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		sharedGreeter := shared.NewGreeter()
		sharedDirectory := &shared.Directory{
			Greeter: sharedGreeter,
		}
		sharedTemplates, err := templates.Load(shared.Templates, "templates", templates.Globals(func(b_ *templates.Binding) templates.FuncMap {
			return templates.FuncMap{
				"badge":       func(a1 string, a1_ int) string { return shared.Badge(b_.Ctx(), a1, a1_) },
				"currentUser": func() (*shared.Viewer, error) { return sharedDirectory.CurrentUser(b_.Ctx()) },
				"greeting":    func() string { return shared.Greeting(b_.Ctx()) },
				"initial":     func(b string) string { return shared.Initial(b_.Ctx(), b) },
				"motto":       func() string { return b.Motto(b_.Ctx()) },
				"nav":         func(prefix string) string { return shared.ActivePrefix(b_.Ctx(), prefix) },
				"tag":         func() shared.Label { return shared.Tag(b_.Ctx()) },
				"widget":      func() b.Widget { return shared.Widget(b_.Ctx()) },
			}
		}))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{
			Directory: sharedDirectory,
			Templates: sharedTemplates,
		}

		r := router.New()

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", webHandlers.Home)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
